recommendedEcosystemSprint.codexPrompt:
Implement Publisher ecosystem sprint for San Francisco: San Francisco Medical Ecosystem Representative Building Foundation

Framework:
- Businesses search for places where their operations can succeed, not for property types.
- Use the Commercial Ecosystem Framework and canonical taxonomy.
- Do not change recommendation rankings, Search Profile questions, or public page design.

Target ecosystem: Medical (medical)
Metro relevance: Important
Current readiness: Partial
Sprint family: Ecosystem Representative Building Foundation

Current layer coverage:
- districts: strong
- recommendations: strong
- representativeBuildings: partial
- buildingBriefs: strong
- subtypes: developed
- archetypes: strong
- activities: strong
- editorialReview: developed

Known gaps:
- Representative Building operational coverage is thin.

Target subtypes:
- medical_office, outpatient_clinic, dental, wellness, hospital_adjacent
Target archetypes:
- medical_practice, dental_practice, physical_therapy_practice, wellness_practice, outpatient_clinic
Target business activities:
- healthcare_delivery, walk_in_service, administrative_operations
Missing representative roles:
- hospital_adjacent_medical_environment, outpatient_clinic_environment
Missing operational categories:
- access_loading
Existing representative buildings:
- 1 Kaiser Plz (medical_office_environment)
District candidates:
- Oakland Medical Campuses

Dependencies:
- Ecosystem classification
- District foundation
- Recommendation foundation
- Representative Building foundation
- Building Brief migration after canonical records exist

Completion criteria:
- Validated district ecosystem classification
- Representative Building coverage across the most important subtypes
- Representative Building intelligence covers roles, business activities, archetypes, and operational validation focus
- Building Brief migration only after canonical records and district association exist
- Publisher ecosystem QA passes without hard errors
- Every target representative role has at least one source-supported building or is explicitly marked research required
- Target operational categories are represented without asserting unverified property features
- Representative Building intelligence QA passes

Guardrails:
- Do not invent districts, buildings, tenants, availability, rents, or unsupported facts.
- Do not deepen office-only coverage when the target ecosystem is different.
- Do not treat taxonomy compatibility as proof that a property has a feature.
- Validate loading, power, parking, yards, lab, food, medical, and permitted-use claims before authoring them as facts.
- Do not recommend Building Brief migration before canonical representative buildings exist.
- Regenerate Publisher snapshots and run ecosystem readiness QA.

Verification:
- npm run publisher:snapshot
- npm run publisher:report
- npm run build
- node scripts/qa-commercial-ecosystem-foundation.js
- node scripts/qa-publisher-ecosystem-readiness.js
- node scripts/qa-representative-building-intelligence.js

Framework:
- Businesses search for places where their operations can succeed, not for property types.
- Use the Commercial Ecosystem Framework and canonical taxonomy.
- Do not change recommendation rankings, Search Profile questions, or public page design.

Target ecosystem: Industrial & Flex (industrial_flex)
Metro relevance: Core
Current readiness: Strong
Sprint family: Ecosystem Balance Sprint

Current layer coverage:
- districts: developed
- recommendations: developed
- representativeBuildings: developed
- buildingBriefs: developed
- subtypes: developed
- archetypes: developed
- activities: strong
- editorialReview: developed

- small_bay_industrial, flex, warehouse, distribution, light_manufacturing
Target archetypes:
- general_contractor, electrician, hvac_company, plumbing_company, landscaper, cabinet_shop

- receiving, shipping, storage, distribution, service_dispatch, light_manufacturing
Missing representative roles:
- food_production_environment, research_development_environment, urban_industrial_environment, industrial_campus_environment

- none identified
Existing representative buildings:
- 1235 Blumenfeld Dr (small_bay_service_environment); 1329 N Market Blvd (last_mile_logistics_environment); 1060 National Dr (warehouse_distribution_environment); 4205 S Market Ct (contractor_service_cluster); 11201 Sun Center Dr (contractor_service_cluster); 11353 Pyrites Way (small_bay_service_environment)

- Natomas, Rancho Cordova Commercial Core, Rocklin Commercial Core, Power Inn Industrial, West Sacramento Industrial

- Ecosystem classification

- Building Brief migration after canonical records exist

recommendedEcosystemSprint.codexPrompt:
Implement Publisher ecosystem sprint for San Diego: San Diego Industrial & Flex Ecosystem Building Brief Migration

Framework:
- Businesses search for places where their operations can succeed, not for property types.
- Use the Commercial Ecosystem Framework and canonical taxonomy.
- Do not change recommendation rankings, Search Profile questions, or public page design.

Target ecosystem: Industrial & Flex (industrial_flex)
Metro relevance: Core
Current readiness: Partial
Sprint family: Ecosystem Building Brief Migration

Current layer coverage:
- districts: developed
- recommendations: developed
- representativeBuildings: developed
- buildingBriefs: missing
- subtypes: developed
- archetypes: developed
- activities: developed
- editorialReview: developed

Known gaps:
- Building Brief coverage is missing for this ecosystem.
- Representative Building intelligence requires editorial review.

Target subtypes:
- small_bay_industrial, flex, warehouse, distribution, light_manufacturing
Target archetypes:
- general_contractor, electrician, hvac_company, plumbing_company, landscaper, cabinet_shop
Target business activities:
- receiving, shipping, storage, distribution, service_dispatch, light_manufacturing
Missing representative roles:
- flex_business_park, warehouse_distribution_environment, last_mile_logistics_environment, light_manufacturing_environment, food_production_environment, showroom_flex_environment, research_development_environment, large_scale_distribution_environment
Missing operational categories:
- infrastructure, market_presence
Existing representative buildings:
- 10130 Sorrento Valley Rd (small_bay_service_environment); San Diego - Sorrento Valley Rd. (small_bay_service_environment); San Diego - Barnes Canyon Rd (small_bay_service_environment); 99Twenty (small_bay_service_environment); San Diego - Kearny Mesa-OF (small_bay_service_environment); 5205 Kearny Villa Way (small_bay_service_environment)
District candidates:
- Sorrento Mesa, Kearny Mesa, Miramar, Otay Mesa, Rancho Bernardo, Poway Business Park, Vista Business Park, Oceanside Industrial

Dependencies:
- Ecosystem classification
- District foundation
- Recommendation foundation
- Representative Building foundation
- Building Brief migration after canonical records exist

Completion criteria:
- Validated district ecosystem classification
- Representative Building coverage across the most important subtypes
- Representative Building intelligence covers roles, business activities, archetypes, and operational validation focus
- Building Brief migration only after canonical records and district association exist
- Publisher ecosystem QA passes without hard errors
- Every target representative role has at least one source-supported building or is explicitly marked research required
- Target operational categories are represented without asserting unverified property features
- Representative Building intelligence QA passes

Guardrails:
- Do not invent districts, buildings, tenants, availability, rents, or unsupported facts.
- Do not deepen office-only coverage when the target ecosystem is different.
- Do not treat taxonomy compatibility as proof that a property has a feature.
- Validate loading, power, parking, yards, lab, food, medical, and permitted-use claims before authoring them as facts.
- Do not recommend Building Brief migration before canonical representative buildings exist.
- Regenerate Publisher snapshots and run ecosystem readiness QA.

Verification:
- npm run publisher:snapshot
- npm run publisher:report
- npm run build
- node scripts/qa-commercial-ecosystem-foundation.js
- node scripts/qa-publisher-ecosystem-readiness.js
- node scripts/qa-representative-building-intelligence.js

recommendedEcosystemSprint.codexPrompt:
Implement Publisher ecosystem sprint for Orange County: Orange County Industrial & Flex Ecosystem Building Brief Migration

Framework:
- Businesses search for places where their operations can succeed, not for property types.
- Use the Commercial Ecosystem Framework and canonical taxonomy.
- Do not change recommendation rankings, Search Profile questions, or public page design.

Target ecosystem: Industrial & Flex (industrial_flex)
Metro relevance: Core
Current readiness: Partial
Sprint family: Ecosystem Building Brief Migration

Current layer coverage:
- districts: developed
- recommendations: developed
- representativeBuildings: developed
- buildingBriefs: missing
- subtypes: developed
- archetypes: developed
- activities: developed
- editorialReview: developed

Known gaps:
- Building Brief coverage is missing for this ecosystem.
- Representative Building intelligence requires editorial review.

Target subtypes:
- small_bay_industrial, flex, warehouse, distribution, light_manufacturing
Target archetypes:
- general_contractor, electrician, hvac_company, plumbing_company, landscaper, cabinet_shop
Target business activities:
- receiving, shipping, storage, distribution, service_dispatch, light_manufacturing
Missing representative roles:
- flex_business_park, contractor_service_cluster, warehouse_distribution_environment, last_mile_logistics_environment, light_manufacturing_environment, food_production_environment, showroom_flex_environment, large_scale_distribution_environment
Missing operational categories:
- market_presence
Existing representative buildings:
- Irvine - Corporate Pointe (research_development_environment); Irvine - Hughes St. (research_development_environment); 1672 Reynolds Ave (research_development_environment); 2671 La Palma Ave (small_bay_service_environment); 3071 E Coronado St (small_bay_service_environment); 4222 E La Palma Ave (small_bay_service_environment)
District candidates:
- University Research Park, Anaheim Canyon, Lake Forest Business Park, Fullerton

Dependencies:
- Ecosystem classification
- District foundation
- Recommendation foundation
- Representative Building foundation
- Building Brief migration after canonical records exist

Completion criteria:
- Validated district ecosystem classification
- Representative Building coverage across the most important subtypes
- Representative Building intelligence covers roles, business activities, archetypes, and operational validation focus
- Building Brief migration only after canonical records and district association exist
- Publisher ecosystem QA passes without hard errors
- Every target representative role has at least one source-supported building or is explicitly marked research required
- Target operational categories are represented without asserting unverified property features
- Representative Building intelligence QA passes

Guardrails:
- Do not invent districts, buildings, tenants, availability, rents, or unsupported facts.
- Do not deepen office-only coverage when the target ecosystem is different.
- Do not treat taxonomy compatibility as proof that a property has a feature.
- Validate loading, power, parking, yards, lab, food, medical, and permitted-use claims before authoring them as facts.
- Do not recommend Building Brief migration before canonical representative buildings exist.
- Regenerate Publisher snapshots and run ecosystem readiness QA.

Verification:
- npm run publisher:snapshot
- npm run publisher:report
- npm run build
- node scripts/qa-commercial-ecosystem-foundation.js
- node scripts/qa-publisher-ecosystem-readiness.js
- node scripts/qa-representative-building-intelligence.js

recommendedEcosystemSprint.codexPrompt:
Implement Publisher ecosystem sprint for Denver: Denver Life Science Ecosystem Subtype Expansion

Framework:
- Businesses search for places where their operations can succeed, not for property types.
- Use the Commercial Ecosystem Framework and canonical taxonomy.
- Do not change recommendation rankings, Search Profile questions, or public page design.

Target ecosystem: Life Science (life_science)
Metro relevance: Secondary
Current readiness: Partial
Sprint family: Ecosystem Subtype Expansion

Current layer coverage:
- districts: missing
- recommendations: missing
- representativeBuildings: missing
- buildingBriefs: missing
- subtypes: missing
- archetypes: developed
- activities: strong
- editorialReview: developed

Known gaps:
- Ecosystem appears only as a secondary district expression.
- Subtype breadth is thin.

Target subtypes:
- research_lab, wet_lab, life_science_office, biotech_research, innovation_campus
Target archetypes:
- research_company, biotech_company, startup
Target business activities:
- research, product_development, collaboration, administrative_operations
Missing representative roles:
- research_lab_environment, life_science_campus, biotech_research_environment
Missing operational categories:
- configuration, infrastructure, market_presence, location_workforce, outdoor_special_use
Existing representative buildings:
- none
District candidates:
- review required

Dependencies:
- Ecosystem classification
- District foundation
- Recommendation foundation
- Representative Building foundation
- Building Brief migration after canonical records exist

Completion criteria:
- Validated district ecosystem classification
- Representative Building coverage across the most important subtypes
- Representative Building intelligence covers roles, business activities, archetypes, and operational validation focus
- Building Brief migration only after canonical records and district association exist
- Publisher ecosystem QA passes without hard errors
- Every target representative role has at least one source-supported building or is explicitly marked research required
- Target operational categories are represented without asserting unverified property features
- Representative Building intelligence QA passes

Guardrails:
- Do not invent districts, buildings, tenants, availability, rents, or unsupported facts.
- Do not deepen office-only coverage when the target ecosystem is different.
- Do not treat taxonomy compatibility as proof that a property has a feature.
- Validate loading, power, parking, yards, lab, food, medical, and permitted-use claims before authoring them as facts.
- Do not recommend Building Brief migration before canonical representative buildings exist.
- Regenerate Publisher snapshots and run ecosystem readiness QA.

Verification:
- npm run publisher:snapshot
- npm run publisher:report
- npm run build
- node scripts/qa-commercial-ecosystem-foundation.js
- node scripts/qa-publisher-ecosystem-readiness.js
- node scripts/qa-representative-building-intelligence.js

Implement Publisher ecosystem sprint for Seattle: Seattle Medical Ecosystem Representative Building Foundation

Framework:
- Businesses search for places where their operations can succeed, not for property types.
- Use the Commercial Ecosystem Framework and canonical taxonomy.
- Do not change recommendation rankings, Search Profile questions, or public page design.

Target ecosystem: Medical (medical)
Metro relevance: Important
Current readiness: Thin
Sprint family: Ecosystem Representative Building Foundation

Current layer coverage:
- districts: strong
- recommendations: strong
- representativeBuildings: missing
- buildingBriefs: missing
- subtypes: developed
- archetypes: developed
- activities: strong
- editorialReview: developed

Known gaps:
- Representative Building coverage is missing for this ecosystem.

Target subtypes:
- medical_office, outpatient_clinic, dental, wellness, hospital_adjacent
Target archetypes:
- medical_practice, dental_practice, physical_therapy_practice, wellness_practice, outpatient_clinic
Target business activities:
- healthcare_delivery, walk_in_service, administrative_operations
Missing representative roles:
- medical_office_environment, hospital_adjacent_medical_environment, outpatient_clinic_environment
Missing operational categories:
- access_loading, parking_vehicles, configuration, infrastructure, market_presence, location_workforce
Existing representative buildings:
- none

- First Hill Medical District

- Ecosystem classification
- District foundation
- Recommendation foundation
- Representative Building foundation
- Building Brief migration after canonical records exist

- Validated district ecosystem classification

- Every target representative role has at least one source-supported building or is explicitly marked research required
- Target operational categories are represented without asserting unverified property features

recommendedEcosystemSprint.codexPrompt:
Implement Publisher ecosystem sprint for San Francisco: San Francisco Medical Ecosystem Representative Building Foundation

Framework:
- Businesses search for places where their operations can succeed, not for property types.
- Use the Commercial Ecosystem Framework and canonical taxonomy.
- Do not change recommendation rankings, Search Profile questions, or public page design.

Target ecosystem: Medical (medical)
Metro relevance: Important
Current readiness: Partial
Sprint family: Ecosystem Representative Building Foundation

Current layer coverage:
- districts: strong
- recommendations: strong
- representativeBuildings: partial
- buildingBriefs: strong
- subtypes: developed
- archetypes: strong
- activities: strong
- editorialReview: developed

Known gaps:
- Representative Building operational coverage is thin.

Target subtypes:
- medical_office, outpatient_clinic, dental, wellness, hospital_adjacent
Target archetypes:
- medical_practice, dental_practice, physical_therapy_practice, wellness_practice, outpatient_clinic
Target business activities:
- healthcare_delivery, walk_in_service, administrative_operations
Missing representative roles:
- hospital_adjacent_medical_environment, outpatient_clinic_environment
Missing operational categories:
- access_loading
Existing representative buildings:
- 1 Kaiser Plz (medical_office_environment)
District candidates:
- Oakland Medical Campuses

Dependencies:
- Ecosystem classification
- District foundation
- Recommendation foundation
- Representative Building foundation
- Building Brief migration after canonical records exist

Completion criteria:
- Validated district ecosystem classification
- Representative Building coverage across the most important subtypes
- Representative Building intelligence covers roles, business activities, archetypes, and operational validation focus
- Building Brief migration only after canonical records and district association exist
- Publisher ecosystem QA passes without hard errors
- Every target representative role has at least one source-supported building or is explicitly marked research required
- Target operational categories are represented without asserting unverified property features
- Representative Building intelligence QA passes

Guardrails:
- Do not invent districts, buildings, tenants, availability, rents, or unsupported facts.
- Do not deepen office-only coverage when the target ecosystem is different.
- Do not treat taxonomy compatibility as proof that a property has a feature.
- Validate loading, power, parking, yards, lab, food, medical, and permitted-use claims before authoring them as facts.
- Do not recommend Building Brief migration before canonical representative buildings exist.
- Regenerate Publisher snapshots and run ecosystem readiness QA.

Verification:
- npm run publisher:snapshot
- npm run publisher:report
- npm run build
- node scripts/qa-commercial-ecosystem-foundation.js
- node scripts/qa-publisher-ecosystem-readiness.js
- node scripts/qa-representative-building-intelligence.js

recommendedEcosystemSprint.codexPrompt:
Implement Publisher ecosystem sprint for Sacramento: Sacramento Industrial & Flex Ecosystem Balance Sprint

Framework:
- Businesses search for places where their operations can succeed, not for property types.
- Use the Commercial Ecosystem Framework and canonical taxonomy.
- Do not change recommendation rankings, Search Profile questions, or public page design.

Target ecosystem: Industrial & Flex (industrial_flex)
Metro relevance: Core
Current readiness: Strong
Sprint family: Ecosystem Balance Sprint

Current layer coverage:
- districts: developed
- recommendations: developed
- representativeBuildings: developed
- buildingBriefs: developed
- subtypes: developed
- archetypes: developed
- activities: strong
- editorialReview: developed

Known gaps:

Target subtypes:
- small_bay_industrial, flex, warehouse, distribution, light_manufacturing
Target archetypes:
- general_contractor, electrician, hvac_company, plumbing_company, landscaper, cabinet_shop
Target business activities:
- receiving, shipping, storage, distribution, service_dispatch, light_manufacturing
Missing representative roles:
- food_production_environment, research_development_environment, urban_industrial_environment, industrial_campus_environment
Missing operational categories:
- none identified
Existing representative buildings:
- 1235 Blumenfeld Dr (small_bay_service_environment); 1329 N Market Blvd (last_mile_logistics_environment); 1060 National Dr (warehouse_distribution_environment); 4205 S Market Ct (contractor_service_cluster); 11201 Sun Center Dr (contractor_service_cluster); 11353 Pyrites Way (small_bay_service_environment)
District candidates:
- Natomas, Rancho Cordova Commercial Core, Rocklin Commercial Core, Power Inn Industrial, West Sacramento Industrial

Dependencies:
- Ecosystem classification
- District foundation
- Recommendation foundation
- Representative Building foundation
- Building Brief migration after canonical records exist

Completion criteria:
- Validated district ecosystem classification
- Representative Building coverage across the most important subtypes
- Representative Building intelligence covers roles, business activities, archetypes, and operational validation focus
- Building Brief migration only after canonical records and district association exist
- Publisher ecosystem QA passes without hard errors
- Every target representative role has at least one source-supported building or is explicitly marked research required
- Target operational categories are represented without asserting unverified property features
- Representative Building intelligence QA passes

Guardrails:
- Do not invent districts, buildings, tenants, availability, rents, or unsupported facts.
- Do not deepen office-only coverage when the target ecosystem is different.
- Do not treat taxonomy compatibility as proof that a property has a feature.
- Validate loading, power, parking, yards, lab, food, medical, and permitted-use claims before authoring them as facts.
- Do not recommend Building Brief migration before canonical representative buildings exist.
- Regenerate Publisher snapshots and run ecosystem readiness QA.

Verification:
- npm run publisher:snapshot
- npm run publisher:report
- npm run build
- node scripts/qa-commercial-ecosystem-foundation.js
- node scripts/qa-publisher-ecosystem-readiness.js
- node scripts/qa-representative-building-intelligence.js

recommendedEcosystemSprint.codexPrompt:
Implement Publisher ecosystem sprint for San Diego: San Diego Industrial & Flex Ecosystem Building Brief Migration

Framework:
- Businesses search for places where their operations can succeed, not for property types.
- Use the Commercial Ecosystem Framework and canonical taxonomy.
- Do not change recommendation rankings, Search Profile questions, or public page design.

Target ecosystem: Industrial & Flex (industrial_flex)
Metro relevance: Core
Current readiness: Partial
Sprint family: Ecosystem Building Brief Migration

Current layer coverage:
- districts: developed
- recommendations: developed
- representativeBuildings: developed
- buildingBriefs: missing
- subtypes: developed
- archetypes: developed
- activities: developed
- editorialReview: developed

Known gaps:
- Building Brief coverage is missing for this ecosystem.
- Representative Building intelligence requires editorial review.

Target subtypes:
- small_bay_industrial, flex, warehouse, distribution, light_manufacturing
Target archetypes:
- general_contractor, electrician, hvac_company, plumbing_company, landscaper, cabinet_shop
Target business activities:
- receiving, shipping, storage, distribution, service_dispatch, light_manufacturing
Missing representative roles:
- flex_business_park, warehouse_distribution_environment, last_mile_logistics_environment, light_manufacturing_environment, food_production_environment, showroom_flex_environment, research_development_environment, large_scale_distribution_environment
Missing operational categories:
- infrastructure, market_presence
Existing representative buildings:
- 10130 Sorrento Valley Rd (small_bay_service_environment); San Diego - Sorrento Valley Rd. (small_bay_service_environment); San Diego - Barnes Canyon Rd (small_bay_service_environment); 99Twenty (small_bay_service_environment); San Diego - Kearny Mesa-OF (small_bay_service_environment); 5205 Kearny Villa Way (small_bay_service_environment)
District candidates:
- Sorrento Mesa, Kearny Mesa, Miramar, Otay Mesa, Rancho Bernardo, Poway Business Park, Vista Business Park, Oceanside Industrial

Dependencies:
- Ecosystem classification
- District foundation
- Recommendation foundation
- Representative Building foundation
- Building Brief migration after canonical records exist

Completion criteria:
- Validated district ecosystem classification
- Representative Building coverage across the most important subtypes
- Representative Building intelligence covers roles, business activities, archetypes, and operational validation focus
- Building Brief migration only after canonical records and district association exist
- Publisher ecosystem QA passes without hard errors
- Every target representative role has at least one source-supported building or is explicitly marked research required
- Target operational categories are represented without asserting unverified property features
- Representative Building intelligence QA passes

Guardrails:
- Do not invent districts, buildings, tenants, availability, rents, or unsupported facts.
- Do not deepen office-only coverage when the target ecosystem is different.
- Do not treat taxonomy compatibility as proof that a property has a feature.
- Validate loading, power, parking, yards, lab, food, medical, and permitted-use claims before authoring them as facts.
- Do not recommend Building Brief migration before canonical representative buildings exist.
- Regenerate Publisher snapshots and run ecosystem readiness QA.

Verification:
- npm run publisher:snapshot
- npm run publisher:report
- npm run build
- node scripts/qa-commercial-ecosystem-foundation.js
- node scripts/qa-publisher-ecosystem-readiness.js
- node scripts/qa-representative-building-intelligence.js

recommendedEcosystemSprint.codexPrompt:
Implement Publisher ecosystem sprint for Orange County: Orange County Industrial & Flex Ecosystem Building Brief Migration

Framework:
- Businesses search for places where their operations can succeed, not for property types.
- Use the Commercial Ecosystem Framework and canonical taxonomy.
- Do not change recommendation rankings, Search Profile questions, or public page design.

Target ecosystem: Industrial & Flex (industrial_flex)
Metro relevance: Core
Current readiness: Partial
Sprint family: Ecosystem Building Brief Migration

Current layer coverage:
- districts: developed
- recommendations: developed
- representativeBuildings: developed
- buildingBriefs: missing
- subtypes: developed
- archetypes: developed
- activities: developed
- editorialReview: developed

Known gaps:
- Building Brief coverage is missing for this ecosystem.
- Representative Building intelligence requires editorial review.

Target subtypes:
- small_bay_industrial, flex, warehouse, distribution, light_manufacturing
Target archetypes:
- general_contractor, electrician, hvac_company, plumbing_company, landscaper, cabinet_shop
Target business activities:
- receiving, shipping, storage, distribution, service_dispatch, light_manufacturing
Missing representative roles:
- flex_business_park, contractor_service_cluster, warehouse_distribution_environment, last_mile_logistics_environment, light_manufacturing_environment, food_production_environment, showroom_flex_environment, large_scale_distribution_environment
Missing operational categories:
- market_presence
Existing representative buildings:
- Irvine - Corporate Pointe (research_development_environment); Irvine - Hughes St. (research_development_environment); 1672 Reynolds Ave (research_development_environment); 2671 La Palma Ave (small_bay_service_environment); 3071 E Coronado St (small_bay_service_environment); 4222 E La Palma Ave (small_bay_service_environment)
District candidates:
- University Research Park, Anaheim Canyon, Lake Forest Business Park, Fullerton

Dependencies:
- Ecosystem classification
- District foundation
- Recommendation foundation
- Representative Building foundation
- Building Brief migration after canonical records exist

Completion criteria:
- Validated district ecosystem classification
- Representative Building coverage across the most important subtypes
- Representative Building intelligence covers roles, business activities, archetypes, and operational validation focus
- Building Brief migration only after canonical records and district association exist
- Publisher ecosystem QA passes without hard errors
- Every target representative role has at least one source-supported building or is explicitly marked research required
- Target operational categories are represented without asserting unverified property features
- Representative Building intelligence QA passes

Guardrails:
- Do not invent districts, buildings, tenants, availability, rents, or unsupported facts.
- Do not deepen office-only coverage when the target ecosystem is different.
- Do not treat taxonomy compatibility as proof that a property has a feature.
- Validate loading, power, parking, yards, lab, food, medical, and permitted-use claims before authoring them as facts.
- Do not recommend Building Brief migration before canonical representative buildings exist.
- Regenerate Publisher snapshots and run ecosystem readiness QA.

Verification:
- npm run publisher:snapshot
- npm run publisher:report
- npm run build
- node scripts/qa-commercial-ecosystem-foundation.js
- node scripts/qa-publisher-ecosystem-readiness.js
- node scripts/qa-representative-building-intelligence.js

- Businesses search for places where their operations can succeed, not for property types.
- Use the Commercial Ecosystem Framework and canonical taxonomy.
- Do not change recommendation rankings, Search Profile questions, or public page design.
